note: 4 decidable-stale of 246 distinct CLAIM subjects; 13 in flight, 12 unkeyable, all counted never scored. Hand vocabulary said 32, shipped says 29, 3 rescued by RELEASE. test_h207_falsify.sh v2: 9 passed, 0 failed.

controls.name: c0_module_green
controls.must_fire_because: the unmutated copy of idscope.py passes its own --selfcheck, so every red below is the mutation and not a broken module
controls.can_fail_because: idscope.py v5 is broken, which voids all 8 mutants
controls.null_must_contain: the C0 arm printing `bad` -- an unmutated copy that FAILS, which the suite prints and then exits 1 without running a mutant

controls.name: c1_v1_accuses_the_module
controls.must_fire_because: the SHIPPED-FOR-THREE-HOURS guard chain reports `suite stayed GREEN with the logic removed` for BOTH degenerate mutants -- a coverage gap alleged in a module that has none. This is the finding, so it is a control.
controls.can_fail_because: v1 already caught them, in which case there is no defect and this row is withdrawn
controls.null_must_contain: v1 returning `THE MUTANT IS EMPTY` or `does not COMPILE` for either mutant -- the whole v1 chain is reproduced verbatim in guard_ab.sh, so the null is reachable by running it

controls.name: c2_chains_agree_on_a_real_mutation
controls.must_fire_because: v1 and v2 both return `caught` on a real one-line mutation and both return `DID NOT APPLY` on no mutation at all, so v2 is a repair and not a different test wearing the same name
controls.can_fail_because: v2 changed the verdict on a genuine mutation, which would make the two columns incomparable
controls.null_must_contain: either chain returning something other than `caught` on the real mutation, or other than `DID NOT APPLY` on the unmutated copy

controls.name: c3_vocabulary_is_not_a_mute_button
controls.must_fire_because: the shipped closer vocabulary still leaves claims accused and closes strictly more subjects than the hand list -- a vocabulary that closed everything would explain the gap just as well and mean nothing
controls.can_fail_because: RELEASE closes every outstanding claim, i.e. the reconciliation is measuring a mute button
controls.null_must_contain: `CONTROL FAILED: the shipped vocabulary closes every claim` -- reconcile.py exits on that string rather than printing a table

controls.name: c4_v4_is_silent
controls.must_fire_because: idscope.py v4 AS COMMITTED IN HEAD prints zero UNCLOSED-CLAIM lines and never names G31/H122/H69, while WORK_QUEUE.md calls all three DONE -- F1 evidence taken from the committed module, not from the v5 header that asserts it
controls.can_fail_because: v4 already reported this direction, in which case F1 fires, this is a routing problem and no code was owed
controls.null_must_contain: any `UNCLOSED-CLAIM` line, or any mention of G31/H122/H69, in the output of the v4 blob checked out of HEAD
controls.detail: git show HEAD:spikes/harness/idscope.py, run on this tree
